title: pinus alba var. nana
intro: Pinus alba var. nana, commonly known as dwarf white pine, is a small evergreen tree or shrub species belonging to the Pinaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may help protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Pinus alba var. nana include wound healing, immune system modulation, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for skin issues and infections. The bioactive constituents of Pinus alba var. nana include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
